purpose: Identify citation claims that need fresh verification before final submission.

claims_requiring_verification.claim: QAOA (Farhi, Goldstone, Gutmann 2014) is the standard variational quantum optimizer.
claims_requiring_verification.current_evidence: Stage 4 doc + widely-known result. No PDF on disk.

claims_requiring_verification.claim: CVaR-QAOA (Barkoutsos et al. 2020) and other risk-aware QAOA variants have prior art.
claims_requiring_verification.verification_required: Cite Barkoutsos et al. 'Improving Variational Quantum Optimization using CVaR', Quantum 4, 256 (2020).

claims_requiring_verification.claim: ACN-Data (Lee, Li, Low 2019) is the standard public EV charging dataset.
claims_requiring_verification.verification_required: Cite Lee, Li, Low 'ACN-Data: Analysis and Applications of an EV Charging Dataset', e-Energy 2019.

claims_requiring_verification.claim: Adaptive penalty ideas (Lagrangian relaxation, ALUgQ) have prior art.
claims_requiring_verification.verification_required: Cite Glover, G. 'A class of linear programming models for quadratic programming', or ANL-7978; also 'ParametricLINGO' (Glover) and ADMM-QL approaches.

claims_requiring_verification.claim: PG&E EV2-A tariff period boundaries (peak 14:00-21:00, off-peak 09:00-14:00 and 21:00-24:00, super off-peak 00:00-09:00).
claims_requiring_verification.verification_required: Cite PG&E Electric Schedule EV (residential time-of-use service for EVs), current effective filing.

claims_requiring_verification.claim: EV charging scheduling under uncertainty has prior art (robust, stochastic, scenario-based).
claims_requiring_verification.verification_required: Cite at least 3-4 representative papers: e.g. Yao et al. (electric vehicle charging station scheduling), Mohsenian-Rad et al. (IEEE Trans. Smart Grid 2010, 2012), Clement-Nyns et al. (2010).

claims_requiring_verification.claim: QUBO formulation of EV charging scheduling has prior art (e.g. Calearo et al., Mansour-Saatlo et al.).
claims_requiring_verification.verification_required: Cite Calearo, L. et al. (2014) and Mansour-Saatlo, A. et al. (2016) for QUBO EV charging formulations.

claims_requiring_verification.claim: Qiskit Aer statevector simulator and the SamplerV2 primitive are the standard statevector simulation path.
claims_requiring_verification.verification_required: Cite Qiskit documentation (Qiskit 0.45+) and the qiskit-aer paper (Tomesh et al. 2022, arXiv:2207.06400).

policy: No citation is fabricated. Every required citation must be verified by the research team before submission.
